END IF
options: C. IF (num = rev) should be IF (temp = rev)

Write a SQL query to find the average marks of students (Example- Student table)
correct_answer: SELECT AVG(Marks) AS AverageMarks FROM Student; OR SELECT SUM(Marks) / COUNT(*) AS Average_Marks FROM Students;

question_text: Write a SQL query to list the names of students studying under the faculty member Kumar - (Example: Table name - Student table)
correct_answer: SELECT Name FROM Student WHERE Course_ID IN (SELECT Course_ID FROM Course WHERE Faculty = 'Kumar'); OR use an equivalent JOIN/EXISTS query between Student and Course filtered by Faculty = 'Kumar'.

question_text: Write a SQL query to display student name and course name (Example: Table name - Student table)
correct_answer: SELECT Student.Name, Course.CourseName FROM Student INNER JOIN Course ON Student.CourseID = Course.CourseID; OR an equivalent join returning student name and course name.

options: A. A feature request from users
B. An error found in the documentation
C. A mismatch between the expected and actual behaviour of the software
correct_answer: C. A mismatch between the expected and actual behaviour of the software

question_text: Which of these following scenarios has the highest priority bug?
options: A. Facebook Add friend request button does not work
B. Facebook like and comment buttons does not work
C. Facebook Log-in button functionality does not work when user tries to login
D. Facebook Share button does not work
correct_answer: C. Facebook Log-in button functionality does not work when user tries to login

question_text:
Write 5 different input test data for PAN number validation, with Valid and Invalid PAN numbers, and specify the result reason in the Remarks column
Preconditions:
The user is on the PAN number input field in a form.
The system is set up to validate the entered PAN number.
Test Data:
Test Case ID
PAN Number
Result
(Valid/Invalid)
Remarks
for the entered PAN number
TC 01
TC 02
TC 03
TC 04
TC 05
correct_answer: PAN validation examples: ABCDE1234Q - Valid; AB12E1234Q - Invalid because first five characters must be alphabets; ABCDE12Q4Q - Invalid because digits must be in positions 6 to 9; ABCDE12345 - Invalid because last character must be an alphabet; abcde1234q - Invalid because PAN is case-sensitive and lowercase is not allowed.

question_text: What is the primary purpose of a test case?
options: A. To define test steps, conditions, and expected outcomes for validation
B. To document software design and architecture details
C. To track coding progress during development
D. To automate all types of testing activities
E. To ensure only functional testing is performed
correct_answer: A. To define test steps, conditions, and expected outcomes for validation

question_text: Assume you are testing the Google Pay (GPay) mobile application. After the app launches successfully, list three test cases you would perform
correct_answer: Any three valid GPay mobile app test cases, such as: verify login/UPI PIN flow, verify sending money to a contact/UPI ID, verify scan-and-pay QR payment, verify transaction history/status, or verify failure handling for wrong PIN or network loss.
